    Other ways to bring in a UG sheet

    If Ultimate Guitar blocks direct access, export from a page you can open.

    1. Drag Export to Open Chords ↗ to your bookmarks bar.
    2. Open a Chords or text Tab page on Ultimate Guitar and click the bookmark.
    3. Upload the downloaded .openchords.json file here.
    On mobile, paste this code into a bookmark URL.

    You can also save the chord page as HTML and upload it. Clear the link field above to import this pasted content.
